wins.text: Diluted EPS up 16% YoY to $1.39, with net income of $4.9 billion
Returned $4.8 billion of capital to shareholders in Q1 via dividends and share repurchases, including $3.5B in buybacks; diluted average shares outstanding down 8% YoY
5 consent orders terminated in Q1 (11 total since 2019), freeing management bandwidth and signaling regulatory progress
Net loan charge-off ratio improved to 45 bps, down 5 bps YoY and 8 bps QoQ, driven by lower commercial losses including CRE office portfolio
Noninterest expense declined 3% YoY on efficiency initiatives; headcount reductions for 19 consecutive quarters

risks.text: NII guided to low end of the 1%-3% growth range vs. 2024, with significant uncertainty around rate path, loan growth, and deposit mix; CFO acknowledged forward curve has moved 40-50 bps lower on the short end in the second half
Tariff-driven economic uncertainty creating client caution; management flagged 'continued volatility and uncertainty' and preparation for 'a slower economic environment in 2025'
Nonperforming assets increased 4% QoQ driven by a rise in commercial and industrial nonaccrual loans
Auto revenue declined 21% YoY on lower loan balances and spread compression; tariff risk to Volkswagen/Audi partnership flagged as an open question
Asset cap remains in place, constraining balance sheet growth in trading (equity finance/prime), loan origination, and deposit-taking; no timeline provided for removal

guidance_items.detail: Full-year 2025 NII now expected at the low end of the prior +1% to +3% vs. 2024 range, citing lower rates, uncertain loan growth, and deposit mix shifts
Full-year 2025 noninterest expense outlook unchanged at approximately $54.2 billion
NII trajectory still expected to be flattish in H1 with a ramp in H2 driven by loan growth, consistent with January guidance

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Impact of consent order closures on management bandwidth and expense savings (not proactively quantified)
Specific C&I sub-sector credit monitoring in a potential downturn
Equity markets business underperformance relative to large-cap peers and asset cap constraints on prime/equity finance growth
